title: Correlated value blind spots: do models share the same omissions in moral/ethical reasoning?

original_idea.body:
# Correlated value blind spots

On ethical-dilemma prompts, query 6-8 models and use a rubric to enumerate which canonical considerations each raises vs omits; test whether omissions are correlated across models. Inference + rubric annotation only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 3: plausible chain (shared moral blind spots are systemic) but the catastrophic-risk pathway is diffuse.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 4: query models + rubric-annotate omissions; building the consideration rubric needs care, guided feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 4: focused deliverable (correlated-omission rate vs chance) with rubric construction as a dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 5: fuzzy-reward value-eval, long-horizon, labs deprioritize, needs no internal access — neglected gold.

novelty.reasoning: Value alignment studied; correlated cross-model omission analysis is plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Extends homogeneity to value reasoning; plausibly open angle.
